description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log entries and appends them to its view, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display formatted log messages within an Android application.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data (priority, tag, message, throwable) and displays it in the LogView. Also forwards logs to the next LogNode if chained.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string and a delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the provided string as a new line to the LogView display.
